hookups.source: MN DNR Sakatah Lake State Park page, seasonal update ('The campground has 14 electric sites, with 20 amp and 30 amp service available'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 14 electric sites, in two of the four loops. ReserveMN lists 61 drive-in sites (13 electric), every one 33 ft or longer, but the park warns spur lengths vary and not every wooded site takes slide-outs.

sites.source: MN DNR park page ('62 Sites' drive-in; '14 Sites' electric, 'Sites are located in two of the four camping loops'; 'RV Length Limit 55 Feet'; 'not all sites in our wooded campground can accommodate slide-outs') + ReserveMN PlaceId 73 unit grid (61 Drive-In / Drive-In Electric units, VehicleLength 33-75), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Showers, flush toilets and dump mid-May to mid-October, weather permitting; drinking water year-round at the hydrant north of the office.

facilities.source: MN DNR park page (Showers / Flush Toilets 'available from mid-May through mid-October, weather permitting'; Vault Toilets 'available year-round'; Dump Station 'Generally operates from mid-May through mid-October'; 'Drinking water is available year-round from the red hydrant north of the park office'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Campground water is off until early May.

season.source: MN DNR park page, seasonal update ('The campground is closed for the 2026 season on October 19th, 2026 ... Camping will be available again April 1, 2027'; 'Reservations are taken from April 1 - October 19'; 'Water will be back on in Early May'), read 2026-11-11

note: Shaded, well-spaced sites in heavy oak woods on the south side of Upper Sakatah Lake, beside the paved Sakatah Singing Hills State Trail. The shallow lake can turn algae-green and smelly in midsummer; no swimming beach. --Claude
summary: DNR park data + ReserveMN read: 62 drive-in sites (ReserveMN 61, all 33 ft+), 14 electric (20/30 amp), 55-ft limit, showers/flush toilets/dump mid-May to mid-Oct, season Apr 1-Oct 19. Pin OK, not waterfront. Fees (ReserveMN 2026-10-12, $24 / electric $34) left as stored.
flags: ReserveMN shows 61 drive-in units (13 electric) vs the DNR's 62 / 14; every listed unit is 33 ft or longer (61 of 61 take a 23-ft rig).
